name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat
Scramble the eggs lightly and remove from pan
Add onions and sauté until translucent
Add rice and soy sauce, stir well
Return eggs to pan and mix everything
Stir-fry for 3 minutes and serve hot

name: Onion Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions
Heat oil in a separate pan
Add sliced onions and minced garlic
Sauté until onions are golden brown
Mix the cooked rice with the onion mixture
Season with salt and pepper to taste

name: Veggie Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper
Heat a non-stick pan with oil
Sauté onions and capsicum until soft
Pour eggs over the vegetables
Cook until edges are set
Sprinkle cheese on top
Fold the omelette and cook for 1 more minute

name: Cheesy Scramble
instructions: Whisk eggs in a bowl until well combined
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat
Pour eggs into the pan
Stir continuously with a spatula
When eggs are almost set, add cheese
Continue stirring until cheese melts
Remove from heat while still creamy

name: Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta according to package instructions until al dente
In a separate pan, sauté minced garlic in olive oil
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft and saucy
Season with salt, pepper, and dried herbs
Add cooked pasta to the sauce and mix well
Sprinkle cheese on top and let it melt
Serve hot with extra cheese on top

name: Paneer Curry
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add chopped onions
Sauté until golden brown, then add ginger and garlic
Add chopped tomatoes and green chillies, cook until soft
Blend the mixture into a smooth paste (optional)
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, and garam masala
Cook the masala until oil separates
Add water to make gravy and bring to a boil
Add paneer cubes and simmer for 5 minutes
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with rice or bread
